title: Commercial AI for large-vessel occlusion detection on CTA, stroke-center evaluation
summary: Viz LVO, a commercial convolutional neural network, scanned 1,167 consecutive head and neck CTAs; of 75 large-vessel occlusions, 61 were detected, giving sensitivity 0.81, NPV 0.99 and accuracy 0.94. In the stroke-protocol subgroup (n = 404) sensitivity was 0.82. The study is retrospective at a single centre, uses neuroradiologist reports as ground truth and evaluates a vendor product.
ai_technology: Commercial convolutional neural network (Viz LVO) detecting large-vessel occlusion on CTA

evidence.tested: Retrospective single-center evaluation of consecutive CTAs (January 2018 to March 2019) against neuroradiologist reports.
evidence.unknown: Effect on treatment times and outcomes; performance at other centres; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional neural network detected large-vessel occlusions on CTA to alert the treatment team.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; affiliations not stated there. Publisher full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
